subject.title: [Bug]: 401 The API key format is incorrect

question: How should OpenClaw handle Volcengine Lite/CodingPlan keys that fail on the general DeepSeek route with a key-format 401?
rationale: Current source and vendor guidance point to a CodingPlan endpoint/model-name mismatch, but changing default provider routing or diagnostics without live entitlement proof could break existing Volcengine users or encode the wrong vendor policy.

options.title: Confirm CodingPlan mapping before fixing
options.body: Have a maintainer or credentialed tester compare the reported general route with `volcengine-plan` CodingPlan model names, then update catalog, diagnostics, docs, and tests around the confirmed behavior.

options.title: Diagnostics-only recovery
options.body: Keep the current catalog split and add clearer setup/runtime diagnostics that point users to CodingPlan endpoint, model, key, and stale models.json checks when this 401 appears.

options.title: Treat as external config
options.body: If live proof shows current OpenClaw routing is correct and only the reporter's key/config was wrong, keep source unchanged and ask for a new issue with current-version repro evidence.

recommendation.title: Confirm CodingPlan mapping before fixing
recommendation.body: Have a maintainer or credentialed tester compare the reported general route with `volcengine-plan` CodingPlan model names, then update catalog, diagnostics, docs, and tests around the confirmed behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses provider-auth aliases, setup behavior, docs, and plugin catalog policy, all areas with recent history from this owner path.
